metadata.description: Deploys a Microsoft Sentinel workspace pre-configured for Agentic AI Security Labs (Track B and Track C).
metadata.author: Microsoft Agentic Security Labs

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the resource group location.
Log retention in days. 30-day default keeps lab cost under $5 USD for a single day of use.
Daily ingestion cap in GB. Prevents unexpected cost overruns during lab use.

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — New Agent Registered Without Owner
properties.description: Fires when a new AI agent is registered in the tenant without an assigned owner or with no Entra identity at all (neither an agent identity nor a blueprint; blueprint-only agents are reviewed with the hunting queries, not alerted). Corresponds to lab Module 01 (Discover & Prioritize). Uses the AgentsInfo table (AIAgentsInfo was retired 1 July 2026 — see Advanced Hunting Schema Naming Changes).
properties.query:
AgentsInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where CreatedDateTime > ago(1d)
| where (isnull(Owners) or array_length(Owners) == 0) or (isempty(EntraAgentID) and isempty(EntraBlueprintID))
| project AgentId, Name, Platform, Owners, EntraAgentID, EntraBlueprintID, LifecycleStatus, CreatedDateTime
| extend AlertDetail = strcat("New agent without owner: ", Name, " | Platform: ", Platform, " | Owners: ", iff(isnull(Owners) or array_length(Owners) == 0, "UNASSIGNED", tostring(Owners)))

properties.description: Detects jailbreak attempts against Copilot/agent interactions using the platform's own JailbreakDetected signal in LLMActivity (Azure Monitor / Log Analytics), rather than a hand-rolled phrase match against CloudAppEvents. Corresponds to lab Module 05 (Detect & Respond) and KQL Library P05-Q1. Query structure matches the official Microsoft documentation example (learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/reference/queries/copilotactivity, confirmed current Sep 2026): table is LLMActivity, RecordType filters to CopilotInteraction, and JailbreakDetected lives inside LLMEventData.Messages (an array — requires mv-expand), not as a flat top-level field.
properties.query:
LLMActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where RecordType == "CopilotInteraction"
| extend Messages = LLMEventData.Messages
| mv-expand Messages
| where tobool(Messages.JailbreakDetected) == true
| project TimeGenerated, ActorName, ActorUserId, AgentName, MessageId = tostring(Messages.Id), JailbreakDetected = tobool(Messages.JailbreakDetected)

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — Potential Bulk Data Retrieval via Agent
properties.description: Detects high-volume SharePoint file access from agent-identified user agents in a short window, which may indicate bulk retrieval or exfiltration. Corresponds to lab Module 04 (Protect Data) and KQL Library P04-Q1. Default threshold (>100 operations/10min) is a starting point — tune against your own agents' baseline before treating alerts as actionable; an unbaselined threshold will generate false positives on legitimate high-volume agents.
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
    and ActionType in ("FileDownloaded", "FileAccessed", "FilePreviewed")
| extend UserAgent = tostring(RawEventData["UserAgent"])
| where UserAgent has_any ("agent", "copilot", "assistant", "power-automate")
| summarize
    OperationCount = count(),
    FileList = make_set(ObjectName, 20),
    FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated)
    by AccountDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where OperationCount > 100
| extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastEvent, FirstEvent)
| project AccountDisplayName, OperationCount, DurationSeconds, FileList, FirstEvent, LastEvent, RiskNote = "Agent bulk access — verify against expected retrieval scope"
